headlines.title: China’s factory-gate prices growth slows to 3.5% in July amid lower fuel prices
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate prices growth slowed in July, as lower domestic fuel prices eased cost pressures triggered by the US-Israel war on Iran, while high temperatures dragged manufacturing.
The producer price index (PPI) rose by 3.5 per cent year on year last month, compared with 4.1 per cent in June, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Sunday.

headlines.summary_zh:

headlines.title_en: Canada signals openness to accepting some auto tariffs in exchange for lower U.S. tariffs
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data, August 13 - According to The Globe and Mail, the Canadian government is considering an automotive tariff plan that aims to accept some U.S. auto tariffs in exchange for the U.S. reducing tariffs on vehicles that meet USMCA standards. The plan includes maintaining the exemption policy, whereby the value of U.S.-produced parts in Canadian auto exports is excluded from tariff calculations. Sources say U.S.-Canada negotiators have discussed the plan. Under preliminary details, tariffs imposed by Trump under Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act of 1962 on autos could be further reduced from the current 25% levied on all Canada auto exports meeting USMCA standards. In addition, the value of U.S. components in Canadian-made vehicles would remain excluded from tariff calculations. headlines.title: Hong Kong’s commercial property investment growth beats peer Asia-Pacific markets
headlines.summary:
Hong Kong’s commercial property investment more than doubled to US$3.1 billion in the second quarter, making it the fastest growing investment market in Asia-Pacific thanks to a strong increase in retail and office deals and a low base effect, according to JLL.
The 129 per cent growth from a year earlier beat other top-performing markets including Singapore with 108 per cent growth and Australia with an 82 per cent increase, data tracked by the property consultancy showed.

headlines.title_zh: 香港商业地产投资增速跑赢亚太其他市场
headlines.summary_zh: 据仲量联行数据，香港商业地产投资第二季度增长逾一倍，达到31亿美元，零售和写字楼交易强劲增长及低基数效应使其成为亚太地区增长最快的投资市场。同比增长129%，超过了新加坡等其他表现最佳的市场。

headlines.title: What makes McDonald’s assets stand out amid a weak Hong Kong retail property market?
headlines.summary:
One year after McDonald’s began selling its self-owned Hong Kong shops, the fast-food giant has found buyers for nearly half its portfolio even as the city’s retail property market endures its weakest spell in decades.
McDonald’s planned to dispose of all 23 shops in phases, market sources said, with the portfolio initially valued at about HK$3 billion (US$382 million).

headlines.title_zh: 在香港零售物业市场疲软之际，麦当劳的资产有何独特优势？
headlines.summary_zh: 麦当劳开始出售其自有香港门店一年后，这家快餐巨头已为其近一半物业找到买家，尽管香港零售物业市场正经历数十年来最疲弱的时期。据市场消息人士称，麦当劳计划分阶段处置全部23家门店，该物业组合最初估值约为30亿港元（合3亿美元）。

headlines.title: 中国主动量化策略首度嵌入境外主动ETF
headlines.summary: 富国基金旗下全资子公司富国香港获银河国际证券（新加坡）有限公司委任为投资顾问，为一只聚焦新加坡本地中小市值股票的主动管理型权益ETF提供选股支持。据悉，该产品已启动发行，预计9月3日在新加坡交易所主板挂牌。近年来，公募“出海”持续升级。在境外机构设置方面，公募境外子公司已超30家，遍布新加坡、北美等地区；产品层面，互联互通发展如火如荼，互挂ETF相继落地，并联合境外多家资管机构发行基金产品，吸引海外资金投资A股。（中国基金报）

headlines.title_en: China's active quantitative strategy debuts in offshore active ETF for the first time
headlines.summary_en: Fullere Fund's wholly-owned subsidiary, Fullere Hong Kong, has been appointed as investment advisor by Galaxy International Securities (Singapore) Co., Ltd. to provide stock selection support for an actively managed equity ETF focused on small- and mid-cap Singapore-listed stocks. The product has reportedly launched and is expected to list on the Singapore Exchange mainboard on September 3. In recent years, public funds have increasingly expanded overseas. Regarding offshore institutions, public fund overseas subsidiaries now exceed 30, spanning regions like Singapore and North America; at the product level, cross-connectivity is thriving, with cross-listed ETFs launching successively, and joint fund products with multiple overseas asset managers attracting foreign capital to invest in A-shares. (China Fund News)

headlines.summary: 金十数据8月13日讯，据《环球邮报》报道，加拿大政府正在考虑一项汽车关税方案，希望以接受部分美国汽车关税为交换，换取美国降低对符合《美墨加协定》（USMCA）标准车辆的关税。方案包括继续维持豁免政策，即加拿大出口汽车中美国生产部分的价值不计入关税征收范围。据消息人士透露，美加谈判人员已讨论该方案。根据初步细节，特朗普依据《1962年贸易扩展法》第232条实施的汽车关税，可能从目前针对所有符合USMCA标准加拿大汽车出口征收的25%进一步降低。此外，加拿大制造汽车中的美国零部件价值仍将被排除在关税计算之外。一辆加拿大生产汽车约有50%的零部件来自美国，企业

headlines.title: 国务院国资委：围绕云计算、网络、人工智能、量子等根技术，加力关键核心技术攻关
headlines.summary: 国务院国资委党委书记、主任程福波到中国电信集团有限公司调研企业科技创新、改革发展和党的建设等工作。程福波强调，要继续抓好新型基础设施建设，坚持适度超前、科学布局、协调发展，统筹推进信息通信网络、全国一体化算力网等建设和集约高效利用，持续推动数字化赋能，提升数智化产品服务供给水平，助力夯实数字经济底座；强化科技创新，围绕云计算、网络、人工智能、量子等根技术，加力关键核心技术攻关，积极推进创新成果转化应用，以更大力度吸引、留住、用好人才，打造网信领域的创新高地和人才高地；抓好提质增效，做实做细精益化管理，主动谋求差异化发展，培育增收增效新增长点；持续深化改革

headlines.title_en: State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission of the State Council: Intensify efforts on tackling key core technologies in foundational areas such as cloud computing, networking, artificial intelligence, and quantum computing.
headlines.summary_en: Cheng Fubo, Party Secretary and Director of the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission of the State Council, visited China Telecom Group to research corporate innovation, reform and development, and Party building. Cheng emphasized continuing to strengthen new infrastructure construction, adhering to适度超前, scientific planning, and coordinated development, promoting the coordinated construction and efficient use of information and communication networks and a national integrated computing network, driving digital empowerment, and improving digital and intelligent product and service supply to strengthen the digital economy foundation; strengthening technological innovation around core technologies like cloud computing, networks, artificial intelligence, and quantum, intensifying efforts in key core technology breakthroughs, actively promoting the application of innovation成果, attracting, retaining, and utilizing talent with greater efforts to build innovation and talent hubs in the cybersecurity and informatization sector; focusing on quality and efficiency improvement, implementing refined management, proactively seeking differentiated development, and cultivating new growth points for revenue and efficiency; and continuing to deepen reforms.
